description: Press the button (green LED off), open the drawer, turn the switch on. The button goes first while the drawer is surely closed, the switch isn't hurt by an open drawer. Random scenes: the joints the task doesn't fix are random at each reset, the blocks lie somewhere on the table, the conditions are rendered in 4 random scenes. Long runs, see dynaguide_scripts/run_long_runs_1.bat and run_long_runs_2.bat. Make it with dynaguide_scripts/make_task.py
